variants.condition: Latest completed hourly close < its own actual-turnover UTC daily VWAP

selection: Four individual families from stage2, frozen before stage3 outcomes. Hot RSI/CRSI test buying near local extension; ROC/VWAP test adding into weak price context. No cross trigger requirement. No threshold, depth, timeframe, direction, persistence, sizing or exit sweep. ATR/ADX/RVOL are logged only, not additional policies. All four run regardless of descriptive cohort rankings.
scope: Veto only otherwise gate-approved AND affordable next-depth11 adds, after all current outer/deep/SR gates. Includes timer-only and genuine-drop adds, reported separately. Re-evaluate each later closed minute: no pending order, no backdated fill, no sticky hold, no reduction of existing inventory. Original sizes, partial clock, exits and lower rungs unchanged. A rebound changing trigger does not bypass the rule while its hourly condition remains true.
availability: Explicit final closed hours, fixed June1 seed, complete minute constituents and modeled zero publication lag. Never use forming hourly close or nearest/stale feature. Unknown required input leaves experimental overlay inactive and is counted; not a proposed live missing-data policy. VWAP compares the last hourly close to that same bar's own UTC-day anchor, not current intrahour price to a future daily total.
baselines: Reproduce all four corrected transactional-clock full-result digests and metrics from accepted sizing study before any variants. Same recent May17 20:43-Sep4 19:01 and longer Jul1 2025-Aug19 2026 21:32 UTC windows, $32000 initial equity, $800 x1.35 max11, 0.055% each side. Resting-touch and close-confirmed TP models; next-open market actions. Do not replace old legacy RSI/CRSI gates with new closed features.
attribution: On unchanged baseline, record otherwise-eligible deep decisions (depth>=9) and distinguish actual fills. Label each rung's eventual after-fee allocation through partial/full exits and end mark separately from full episode outcome. Feature-only JSONL is separate from future outcome JSONL. Broad depth>=9 descriptive rows are NOT extra depth>=9 policy tests. Correlated/repeated rungs within episodes are not independent trials; attribution is not skip-add PnL.
screens: Reuse unchanged baseSpec profit and defensive screens, including at least20 affected recent episodes per TP model, no extra post-result thresholds. Report all W/L dollars and monthly losses/net beside baselines even if no qualifier. Extra5bps/side fixed-path cost stress is labeled, not a new replay. No live candidate from this mined history alone.
limits: Previously mined overlapping windows, not untouched out-of-sample. Long-only modeled account, not actual live PnL, native/maker queue, 10s decision cadence, lot fragmentation, liquidation, outages or funding settlement certification. Earlier hourly math/zero-lag and historical data provenance limitations remain. Later indicator/HL/SR combinations and short changes unrun. No live config/state/process changes, commit or push.
